dose.queue: empty at submit (verified), one batched job, 4 families sequential

dose_vs_anchor_v1.reading: second run-to-run instance beside variance_probe (v8/v6 median 1.0181): independent corroboration of the 6.6 spread discipline

followup_wrapper_fix: dose.sh wraps run_family.sh, so the queue matcher (own_command_substr='run_family.sh <fam>') resolves a STALE job id and self leaks into n_other_*. Next dose: match own job by id/description (e.g. U2O_JOB_DESC='u2o.6.6 dose' + description-substring match), so own_job_entry resolves and the queue axis is verifiable in-record. Named per PI ruling 2026-10-06; not implemented here (no unverified harness change).

gemm.convention: discard on ANY fired clause (bias, systematic); gaps are stated omissions and never count as passes; temperature reads the BEFORE (ambient) boundary only per PI ruling 2026-10-06 -- post-run heat is our own workload's exhaust, not a co-tenant
fired_clauses: queue_state n_other_running_at_sample_time=[1, 1]: a queue-routed tenant was running at sample time
gemm.population: one family's boundary records: telemetry_before/after plus queue_state_before/after

self_attribution.attribution_basis: PI ruling 2026-10-06 option (b): entries id-equal to the dose job attributed out; any other id still discards
self_attribution.reading: queue '1' is the dose job itself on both boundaries (id match), no external tenant; recorded own_job_id is stale (matcher predates dose.sh), so contention-freedom rests on gapless telemetry
